title: Godot crashes when you run a script with a Packed*Array variable and two or more awaits
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible: Godot v4.7.dev (74b5be24f) - Latest master, Godot 4.7 dev 2 official - Not reproducible: Godot 4.7 dev 1 official ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (74b5be24f) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8531) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory ### Issue description Godot crashes when running a script that cointains a `Packed*Array` variable and two `await`'s in certain situations. The crash is easily reproducible on a binary compiled with `dev_build=yes`, but i was able to trigger in Godot 4.7 dev 2 official too (is more rare, require a lot of tries and at least 3 await's). Reverting PR #116711 fixed the issue.
From what i tested, Godot crashes if: ``` extends Node func _ready() -> void: # An await before and one after the variable await get_tree().process_frame var a: PackedStringArray await get_tree().process_frame ``` ``` extends Node func _ready() -> void: # Two awaits after the variable var a: PackedStringArray await get_tree().process_frame await get_tree().process_frame ```
But doesn't crash: ``` extends Node func _ready() -> void: # Two awaits before the variable await get_tree().process_frame await get_tree().process_frame var a: PackedStringArray ```
